subject: Semantic alignment scorecard & pilot next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Semantic alignment scorecard & pilot next steps

Thanks again for the productive call this morning, Emma — appreciate the walkthrough of the NimbleSearch search use cases and the sample corpus you shared. High-level recap and suggested next steps below so we have a single place to track the pilot scope.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: improve FAQ/KB retrieval precision for support agents (reduce time-to-answer, fewer escalations).
- Data: ~3M docs, mixed short-form articles and long technical notes; initial pilot will use a 50k doc subset (privacy-filtered).
- Constraints: low latency requirement for agent UI (<60ms embed lookup + retrieval), and SOC2 controls around PII handling.

Redwood recommended embedding candidates (to evaluate in pilot)
- rwd-embed-semantic-v2 (1536 dims) — best overall semantic fidelity in our internal benchmarks, slightly higher compute than compact models.
- rwd-embed-lowlat-1 (1024 dims) — lower cost/latency; useful if throughput/latency dictates compromise.
- rwd-embed-quantized-int8 (1536 dims, quantized) — for throughput testing; watch for regression on fine-grained nDCG.

Benchmarks & resources
- Quick scorecard notebook (run on your 1k query holdout): https://github.com/redwood-inference/embed-eval-notebooks/blob/main/semantic_scorecard.ipynb
- Example prompt sets and positive pairs: attached pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv
- Raw benchmark outputs from our initial sweeps (for reference): attached semantic-bench-results-raw.zip

Proposed pilot success criteria (suggested)
- Recall@10 >= 0.82 on your 1k query holdout
- nDCG@10 >= 0.76
- Median cosine drift relative to current production baseline < 0.02
- End-to-end median latency (embedding + retrieval) < 60ms in your staging environment

Quality/regression concerns to monitor
- Quantization can reduce fine-grained ranking quality (we've seen ~0.02-0.04 nDCG drop when moving to aggressive int8 paths on some corpora).
- Dimensionality trade-offs: lower-dim models reduce cost/latency but sometimes miss topical nuance in long technical docs.
- Prompt set skew: ensure diversity (short question, paraphrase, full-sentence context) — we included examples in pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv.

Next steps / ask from NimbleSearch
1) Confirm the 50k privacy-filtered subset for the pilot (we can advise on filtering if useful).
2) Share a preferred 1k QA/holdout for scoring (if you don't have one, Redwood can sample and propose).
3) Approve a week-long run window (we'll run the three candidate embeddings and return scorecards + traces).
4) Kickoff meeting: Wed Jul 28 10:00am PT — would that work?

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik on the eval plan; they will own the scoring and kernel/quantization notes. Attaching NDA/SLA request doc in case procurement wants it up front.

Best,

Adding technical detail for the pilot run and the scoring script I'll execute: 

Evaluation plan (Marissa's notes)
- Datasets to run: (a) 50k privacy-filtered index, (b) 1k labeled queries (holdout), (c) 5k sampled drift checks from the last 6 months.
- Models to sweep: rwd-embed-semantic-v2 (1536), rwd-embed-lowlat-1 (1024), rwd-embed-quantized-int8 (1536).
- Metrics computed: Recall@1/5/10, nDCG@5/10, MAP, median cosine similarity distribution, percentile drift (90th pct change).

Thresholds & quick heuristics
- Target: Recall@10 >= 0.82 and nDCG@10 >= 0.76 as Mina proposed. If quantized model misses nDCG by <= 0.02 but offers >25% latency savings, we flag it as a candidate for mixed deployment (hot-path production + cold-path batch).
- Dimensionality: 1536-d tends to show higher nDCG on long-form docs; for NimbleSearch's corpus I expect ~+0.015 nDCG vs 1024-d in our prior runs.
- Quantization risk: int8 paths can introduce variance in tail queries (long technical paragraphs). Run stratified evaluation on technical-doc group specifically.

Execution notes
- I'll run the GitHub notebook (linked above) with our trace instrumentation enabled — it will produce per-query token counts, embedding latency, and answers for manual spot-checking.
- Please give SFTP credentials for the holdout and a contact for procurement; I'll keep raw outputs in the attached zip and redact any PII before sharing.

Attachments I'll push to the drive folder before the kickoff: pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (already attached), and a small template for the scoring report.

Marissa Cole
Applied ML / Eval Lead, Redwood Inference
